edit_chain.prompt:
Edit the supplied five-view Hot Wheels reference sheet. Correct the two SIDE-VIEW panels, keeping the overhead, front and rear panels unchanged.

Replace the upper two views with physically correct orthographic lateral elevations of the SAME green Nissan Skyline toy. Top row vehicle-right facing RIGHT; second row vehicle-left facing LEFT. Move each camera to exact mid-door height and exactly perpendicular to the door. Zero pitch, zero yaw. In a true side elevation the front grille/bumper FACE and rear lamp-panel FACE have zero visible width. Currently the front corners are showing: rotate the camera until those faces disappear completely behind the side silhouette. Do not merely erase the front markings. The nose must have the correct thin edge-on contour. A side headlamp edge may exist, but NOT a headlamp or fog-lamp face. Wing supports overlap in projection. No broad roof, hood or trunk upper surfaces and no view down into seats.

Preserve actual 3D body proportions, roof height, wheelbase, wheel diameter, ride height, body molding and wing. Do NOT squash the car to hide top planes. Preserve rounded metallic green highlights, dark spoke recesses, chrome rim lips, tire volume and cabin depth. This remains a photograph of a physical miniature, not a flat vector illustration.

Keep the square fuel flap on vehicle-RIGHT only (top row); no fuel flap on vehicle-left (second row). Do not mirror the first side to make the second. Keep black 10-spoke wheels with chrome outer lips. No newly painted headlights.
Keep the five-view/four-row layout and same scale, complete silhouettes and white gutters. Pure white #FFFFFF outside each car, no floor, no cast/contact shadows or halo. No labels or additional view. Output a full corrected sheet.

Edit ONLY the bottom FRONT and REAR panels of this five-view green Nissan Skyline, green unpainted molded headlights, black grille/lower lip, printed red rear lamps, left rear exhaust toy sheet. Preserve the upper two strict side elevations and middle overhead panel exactly, including all their silhouettes, positions, size, materials, colors and graphics.

Re-photograph the bottom two views as exact engineering FRONT and REAR ELEVATIONS with photographic 3D material depth. Put each orthographic camera at BUMPER HEIGHT, pointing EXACTLY HORIZONTALLY along the car length, with zero pitch/yaw/roll. The current view is from too high and sees far down across the hood. LOWER the camera until the hood/deck horizontal upper planes have effectively zero projected height; retain only a thin true slope/curved contour. No broad roof top or hood artwork surface visible. Rear view must not look down onto rear deck or wing. Do not flatten or squash the body or shorten the cabin. Preserve actual car height/width, wheel stance and all fascia details. This is an optical camera correction, not an erasing operation.

Keep the same five-view layout, complete silhouettes, same front/rear scale, and all source toy simplifications. Keep dimensional softbox reflections on metal, shadowed recesses ON the toy, rounded tires and dark glazing. Smooth tiny metallic flecks, not decorative swirled paint. Pure white outside car silhouettes, no floor, contact/cast shadows, halos, labels or borders.
